title: Tiny, cute castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='10' y='82' width='80' height='10' rx='3' fill='#3d7a3a'/>
  <!-- main castle body -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='38' rx='3' fill='#c9b8a0'/>
  <!-- main body shading -->
  <rect x='55' y='45' width='15' height='38' rx='3' fill='#b3a28a'/>
  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='20' y='35' width='16' height='48' rx='3' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='35' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#c9b8a0'/>
  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='64' y='35' width='16' height='48' rx='3' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <rect x='64' y='35' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#c9b8a0'/>
  <!-- center tower -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='20' height='18' rx='2' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <rect x='52' y='28' width='8' height='18' rx='2' fill='#d9c9b0'/>
  <!-- left tower top crenellation -->
  <rect x='18' y='30' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <rect x='28' y='30' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <!-- right tower top crenellation -->
  <rect x='62' y='30' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <rect x='72' y='30' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#e0cfb8'/>
  <!-- center tower top crenellation -->
  <rect x='38' y='23' width='5' height='6' rx='1' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <rect x='47' y='23' width='5' height='6' rx='1' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <rect x='56' y='23' width='5' height='6' rx='1' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <!-- roof on left tower -->
  <polygon points='18,30 28,18 38,30' fill='#d94f4f'/>
  <!-- roof on right tower -->
  <polygon points='62,30 72,18 82,30' fill='#d94f4f'/>
  <!-- center roof -->
  <polygon points='38,23 50,12 62,23' fill='#f06a6a'/>
  <!-- flag pole -->
  <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='4' stroke='#7a6a5a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- flag -->
  <polygon points='50,4 62,7 50,10' fill='#ffcf40'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <path d='M43,83 L43,68 Q50,58 57,68 L57,83 Z' fill='#7a4a2a'/>
  <path d='M49,83 L49,68 Q50,65 51,68 L51,83 Z' fill='#5a3218'/>
  <!-- door arch highlight -->
  <path d='M43,68 Q50,58 57,68' fill='none' stroke='#a87050' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- windows left tower -->
  <rect x='24' y='48' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <!-- windows right tower -->
  <rect x='70' y='48' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <rect x='70' y='62' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <!-- window on body -->
  <rect x='38' y='52' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='52' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#5ab4e0'/>
  <!-- stone texture dots -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='75' r='1.5' fill='#b3a28a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#b3a28a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#b3a28a'/>
  <!-- little bushes -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='84' r='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='86' r='4' fill='#3d8b40'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='84' r='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='86' r='4' fill='#3d8b40'/>
  <!-- tiny flowers -->
  <circle cx='13' cy='90' r='2' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='90' r='2' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#ffcf40'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#ffcf40'/>
</svg>
